title: Construct a custom remote authentication service with logging
goal: Forward the matching typed logger when migrating a custom RemoteAuthenticationService subclass while keeping its account mapping, provider options and token-request outcomes.

selectionNotes: Custom subclasses/factories forward the exact generic framework-service ILogger type. The five-argument constructor already works on .NET 10; ordinary DI consumers need no rewrite.
The controlled JS adapter proves actual DI/options/logging, account mapping and token-result handling; not external-provider login or token issuance.
